issues.detail: Initial exam selection assumed data-row-id was the entity ID; this table uses row-model IDs. Filter by the API class and exact title, assert one row, then compare date/type/status/section.
Page header and calendar period are both h2. Scope the period heading to its displayed year.
Arabic formatting uses ar-MA, including the July month name and currency text; initial expectations used generic ar.
The phone header intentionally hides its subtitle. Assert rendered count metadata there; stat cards and student rows remain visible.
Sidebar labels live under navigation. After selecting a year, close the drawer explicitly and wait for its bounds to move off-screen; a transformed button is still visible to the locator.
Playwright screenshot capture clipped the native zoom surface. Final private images use CDP Page.captureScreenshot without a CSS clip. Capturing the surface does not change viewport or app styling.

repeatPolicy: Accepted main and focused follow-up checks are combined once; native zoom repeats are counted once. Fee comparisons after navigation/reload are separate workflow checkpoints.
